fieldNotes.siteResolution: Given coords (49.3827,-121.4414) landed in downtown residential Hope, ~5km too far west. Address 66700 Othello Rd geocoded (Nominatim) to 49.38517,-121.38221, which satellite z17 confirmed as a large industrial building in a forest clearing east of Kawkawa Lake - consistent with web reporting that the Nestle Waters / BlueTriton (now Primo Brands) plant 'bottles water from the aquifer just east of Kawkawa Lake.' Locked center ~49.38515,-121.38215.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or pinch-point checkpoint visible where the single private access drive enters the paved yard (z20 p03-yard-entry). The drive opens directly into the parking/yard area. Marked false. MEDIUM-LOW confidence: a gate could sit lower on the ~300m winding private drive through forest, outside captured frames, and there is NO Street View coverage of the drive or yard to confirm (nearest pano is 49.38160,-121.38689 on the public road ~300m SW, dense forest only, captured 2023-06).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth-sized structure (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-side windows) at the yard entry or along the drive in any satellite crop. False.
fieldNotes.streetView: No usable Street View anywhere near the plant or its access drive. Probed ~11 points; only OK pano was 49.3815957,-121.3868879 (Othello Rd, 2023-06) which shows only forest and a road marker - the plant and its gate are not visible. All zone streetViewMeta set hasCoverage:false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks run along the NW/north wall of the warehouse: ~8-12 trailers backed in perpendicular to the building wall (z19 p03-nw-trailers), implying a continuous dock-door bank. A smaller dock/load point sits at the S/SW corner near the round water tank (z20 p03-south). Total honest estimate ~16; banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A row of ~5-6 trailers/containers parked nose-out in a dedicated storage row at the NW corner of the yard, separate from the active dock line (z19 p03-nw-trailers, z18 p03-plant). Banded 10-25 (low side).
fieldNotes.dropYard: True - the NW trailer/container storage row is a distinct staging/storage area separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cannot confirm split ship/receive from imagery; docks appear concentrated on the NW wall with a minor S-corner dock. Marked false; low confidence.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: The large open paved apron on the NW/W side between the dock line, the trailer storage row, and the access drive acts as an internal queue/staging area inside the property.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Private access drive winds ~300m up through forest from the public road (Othello Rd) to the yard, plus a deep internal apron - easily holds 3+ trucks queued before docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single access drive serves both in and out; no separate exit lane observed.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~8-12 backed at the NW dock wall + ~5-6 in the NW storage row + 1 tractor-trailer parked along the SW access road = ~18. Approximate; mixed imagery vintages.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Tight forest-bounded yard; NW storage row + apron realistically hold ~25 trailers. Constrained site.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large connected industrial complex (two roof sections: lighter N warehouse + main S building under one footprint) plus a minor NE tank/utility structure up a separate dirt spur - counted as 1 main building.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~5.24 acres of cleared/paved operational footprint derived from the perimeter polygon; the broader spring/aquifer property is far larger but is forest, not yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; access is the single private road only. False.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Plant sits in an isolated forested valley clearing east of Kawkawa Lake with no adjacent development -> likely weak cellular coverage. Inferred, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.imageryQuality: Maxar/Airbus 2026 base imagery, clear; building and yard read well at z18-z20. The forested approach drive obscures the lower entrance, and there is zero Street View, so gate determination rests on satellite alone.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Single-lane open drive into a tight yard; no wide gate apron or multi-lane room to add a bypass. False.
